text:
zoe: Heads-up: nightly-eval flagged v2c-quant as regressing on structured-output prompt set. 18/200 prompts failing, most are truncated JSON fields. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/evals/17677 :eyes:
eval-bot: nightly-eval run completed; job id run-2026-03-19-03:22. metrics: structured_json_exact_match down 12.3%, avg_gen_length -14 tokens.
ali: copying example outputs, looks like tokenizer merging causes broken separators. example:
```
Input: {"question": "list items"}
Gen (v2c-quant): "[\"item1\",\"item2\",\"item3"
```
missing closing bracket.
sandra: did we change tokenizers in v2c weights? I thought only weights changed.
miguel: v2c upload did include a small SentencePiece vocab tweak to add a few domain tokens, but the quant pipeline also applied q4_0 groupwise. suspect off-by-one in EOS handling under q4_0 runtime path.
ali: I reproduced locally with q4_0 + runtime-1.3.5. Rolling back runtime to 1.3.4 fixes truncation. Patching runtime tokenization path to treat eos token as standalone also fixes.
zoe: can you share minimal repro? we need a quick canary patch for Dedicated and Hosted structured routes.
ali: repro script:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(model='v2c-quant', runtime='1.3.5')
prompt='Generate JSON list of 3 items: name, id, type'
print(c.generate(prompt, max_tokens=64))
```
Observed: output missing final `]` and sometimes trailing field names merged with next token.
miguel: opening a triage ticket with steps and cross-run logs, will run cross-quant/backcompat matrix (q4_0, q8_0, float) and runtime versions. tagging @eng-runtime.
sandra: for immediate mitigation, add fallback routing to v2c-float for structured-output routes until fix. I can patch the rollout policy and add a canary percent to catch regressions.
zoe: yes do that. Also please add a regression alert on structured_json_exact_match with a lower threshold so this trips earlier.
ali: created PR adjusting eos handling in kv cache flush + token merge guard, PR: https://git.redwood/PR/1234 :thumbsup:
eval-bot: alert suppressed: routing rule applied to service=answers-structured, target=v2c-float.
